# TradeLink by PeakBot

> TradeLink is a cloud-based futures trade copier made by PeakBot. You place a trade in one leader account and TradeLink copies the leader's fills to follower accounts, with per-follower sizing and risk rules. One plan: $40/month, unlimited supported connections, up to 150 accounts.

Key facts (checked 2026-10-16):
- Price: $40/month, one plan. No standard free trial. Traders switching from another paid futures copier get the first month free plus $20 after the first successful renewal, with proof of cancellation.
- Connections: futures accounts connect through a Tradovate login, live or paper. Rithmic is coming soon and isn't live yet.
- Copying: fill-based, including partial fills. Followers can copy 1:1, by multiplier or by fixed quantity. Unlimited copy groups.
- Risk: ten protection rules, including daily loss and profit limits. You can pause, flatten or lock one follower or a whole group.
- Runs server-side, so no browser window or VPS needs to stay open.
- Includes a trade journal with CSV export.
- Copying doesn't guarantee identical fills. Check each prop firm's copy-trading rules.
